item.title: It Looks Like Higher Rates Are on the Way
AI Debt Blowups Become Fodder for ETFs Aimed at Retail Investors
item.description: Two investment firms are seeking to launch exchange-traded funds that would let retail investors bet on fear about potential credit defaults at artificial intelligence companies, just as the AI trade reels from one of its sharpest selloffs in years.

item.title: China’s Iron Ore Buying Clout Makes Each Deal a Market Event
item.description: State-backed iron ore buyer China Mineral Resources Group Co. has had a good year, securing deals with two of its biggest suppliers that establish its dominance of a market worth north of $100 billion.

item.title: Anthropic Investors Shop IPO Shares Early, and at a Big Premium
item.description: Some Anthropic PBC backers are offering a portion of their IPO allocation to new investors in the run-up to the largest public listing on record.

item.title: CBA Profit Climbs as Banks Grapple With Slide in Mortgage Volume
item.description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia’s first-quarter profit climbed as growth in loans to businesses by the country’s largest lender offset struggles in mortgages during the housing slump.
